name: radial-petal-projection
description: geoPolarPetal - an interrupted radial petal D3 projection, packaged as a real ES module (import { geoPolarPetal } from "radial-petal-projection") built on d3-geo's raw-projection convention. index.html and transition-demo.html run with no build step via an import map resolving d3/d3-geo/topojson-client to a CDN.

scripts.test: node test/seam-audit.mjs && node test/fill-partition.mjs && node test/equal-area.mjs
